svg.text: host: display DevKitC — GPIO4 — one channel
SK6812 x6 — one uncut segment, one pixel per member
THE CIRCUIT — one data wire, one power domain
(stripboard, same stock as the fuse board)
clear silicone sleeve stays on = diffuser
the strip's own copper is the chain — zero link wires, zero tinning
raw red/grey injection pair: capped + twist-tied (6 px needs no injection)
6 px full white uncapped = 480 mA — the fw cap is the budget
remainder reel = spare, cut fresh at its own pad line if ever used
it glows through the front slot
Uncut segment + factory JST pair. One host, one wire.
Power all from the DevKitC 5V pin = one domain, no ground loops. Firmware caps brightness at 25% (worst case under 100 mA).
Any floating /OE = dead outputs. All four go to GND even though
only channel 1 is used. Unused A-inputs to GND; unused Y stay open.
Build order: power rails — tack pins 1+8 corners — seat flat — remaining 12
pins (3 s max each) — 330R — wire tails — JST socket last.
No IC socket: the chip solders direct. AHCT is tough; keep dwell short.
SEGMENT PREP — one cut, no solder
arrow = data flow: the factory pigtail end IS the input
ONE firm snip through sleeve+strip in the TRACE GAP
no exposed copper at either lip — nothing to wrap,
BEFORE the cut, via the far-end connector:
red+gnd beep reel-long, green by elimination
injection pair: trim, sleeve with salvaged spool
tips join the strip power rails — JST never mates until capped

g.text: 1A tail to GPIO4 dupont, Y1 through R to JST data pin
counterpart red+gnd tips to FAR-END connector
both beep reel-long — green by elimination
green lead to red lead + green lead to black lead
OPEN both — a beep = bad pigtail
DevKitC USB on — board 5V rail to GND rail
nothing lit, nothing warm (finger on each px + chip)
dots walk px0 to px5 — white, green, blue, red
capitán gold — cimarrón faint green — vigía blue — cabildo purple
pull any node's USB-C, then replug
its px RED within 3 s — the role colour returns on rejoin
push an OTA to any node from the PC
that px holds AMBER for the transfer

svg.text: TROUBLE: sweep dark = redo first power, then Y1–330R–JST path + reseat the plug — wrong colours = GRBW order, firmware-side fix
one px dark mid-bar = strip fault (cut a fresh segment) — flicker = reseat JST or 470–1000 µF at head (order only if seen)
iron stays cold — scissors + meter only
